name: John Deere Waterloo Foundry - Waterloo IA

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed John Deere Waterloo Foundry at 2000 Westfield Ave, Waterloo IA. Roster ROOFTOP coords (moved 180m) landed on the large foundry building mass along the Cedar River; locked center refined to 42.5072,-92.3650.
fieldNotes.truckGate: CONFIRMED via Street View (2026 imagery, 42.5049,-92.3648). Multiple yellow barrier arms span the truck lanes, with a chain-link perimeter fence and gates. Definitive controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: CONFIRMED. A brick gatehouse with a brown peaked-roof canopy sits directly beside the truck lanes between the inbound and outbound sides — a classic 1-3-vehicle-footprint staffed guard booth. Clearly visible in the 2026 Street View gate shots.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE. Rail tracks run alongside the foundry building between the building and the river levee, with spurs adjacent to the building (z18/z19 at 42.5085,-92.3645). Foundries typically receive scrap/pig iron by rail.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved staging/parking area immediately inside the gate before the docks (visible in the SV east-facing gate shot) — confirmed.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved approach from the gate to the dock building easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and multi-lane layout (lanes on both sides of the guard booth) — ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~20 dock doors across the foundry building's loading faces; a dock-door bank is visible in the SV east-facing gate shot. Approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Few unaccompanied drop trailers observed (~8); the staging area is large but lightly used in the captured imagery. Band 0-10, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated paved staging/trailer yard inside the gate; set true.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the industrial fabric of Waterloo IA — residential neighborhood adjacent to the SW, US-218 highway corridor, the broader Waterloo Works campus around it — Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building foundry complex (4+ distinct large building masses) on one property.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound / 2 outbound from the gate layout; exact count partly obscured.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified; left false, flagged uncertain.
